editorial:
Imagine a world where a fading celebrity and a brand new internet star collide in the weirdest way possible. You get a story about a guy who thinks he is still a big deal, but he is mostly just dealing with a long line of ex-wives who cannot stand him. Then he meets a girl half his age who is famous online, and things go from awkward to dangerous very quickly. It feels like a wild ride that mixes laughs with a creepy vibe, especially once a mysterious stalker in a monkey mask starts showing up. It is the kind of movie that keeps you guessing if you should be laughing or hiding under your blanket.

The acting is surprisingly good for a movie this quirky, and the pacing keeps you moving right along without any boring spots. While some of the plot twists might feel a bit over the top, that is part of the charm. You should definitely check this out if you like stories about fame gone wrong. Since it is an older flick, you might want to look for it on a 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best quality, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with a shocking reveal about who is actually behind the monkey mask. You find out that the stalking was a calculated move tied to jealousy and the desire for fame. After a tense showdown, the truth comes out and the villain is stopped. The main characters are left to pick up the pieces of their messy lives, realizing that internet fame is not as glamorous as it looks on a screen.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies and stories about obsessed fans.
